title: Seven minutes, one number
clue: A crypto exchange account was emptied in seven minutes. The carrier's timeline export is scrambled. Submit the flag for how the attacker received the reset code.
evidence: analyst note  the carrier scrambles exports by xor with the ticket number
carrier       ticket 58213: SIM change approved at a store after the caller said the phone was lost
owner phone   forensic scan clean; no apps installed in the last 30 days
exchange      reset was done with an SMS code; the old password was never entered
hints: The artifact is hex, but plain hex decode gives noise. Something is keyed.
The key is a number in the evidence. After xor, the text uses a 64-character alphabet.
The phone was clean and no password was used. Where did the SMS go?
